title: Delete Characters to Make Fancy String
statement: Remove characters so no three consecutive characters are equal.

title: Delete Characters to Make Fancy String
statement: Remove characters so no three consecutive characters are equal.
code: class Solution { public String makeFancyString(String s){StringBuilder b=new StringBuilder();for(char c:s.toCharArray()){int n=b.length();if(n<2||b.charAt(n-1)!=c||b.charAt(n-2)!=c)b.append(c);}return b.toString();} }

title: Check If String Is a Prefix of Array
statement: Return true if s equals the concatenation of a nonempty prefix of words.

title: Check If String Is a Prefix of Array
statement: Return true if s equals the concatenation of a nonempty prefix of words.
code: class Solution { public boolean isPrefixString(String s,String[] words){StringBuilder b=new StringBuilder();for(String w:words){b.append(w);if(b.toString().equals(s))return true;if(b.length()>=s.length())return false;}return false;} }

title: Number of Strings That Appear as Substrings in Word
statement: Count patterns that occur as substrings of word.
approach_name: Count patterns contained in the word
code:
class Solution:
 def numOfStrings(self,patterns,word):return sum(p in word for p in patterns)

title: Number of Strings That Appear as Substrings in Word
statement: Count patterns that occur as substrings of word.
approach_name: Count patterns contained in the word
code: class Solution { public int numOfStrings(String[] patterns,String word){int n=0;for(String p:patterns)if(word.contains(p))n++;return n;} }

title: Find if Path Exists in Graph
statement: Return whether an undirected path exists between source and destination.

title: Find if Path Exists in Graph
statement: Return whether an undirected path exists between source and destination.
code:
import java.util.*;
class Solution { public boolean validPath(int n,int[][] edges,int source,int destination){List<List<Integer>>g=new ArrayList<>();for(int i=0;i<n;i++)g.add(new ArrayList<>());for(int[]e:edges){g.get(e[0]).add(e[1]);g.get(e[1]).add(e[0]);}boolean[]seen=new boolean[n];ArrayDeque<Integer>st=new ArrayDeque<>();st.push(source);seen[source]=true;while(!st.isEmpty()){int x=st.pop();if(x==destination)return true;for(int y:g.get(x))if(!seen[y]){seen[y]=true;st.push(y);}}return false;} }

title: Minimum Time to Type Word Using Special Typewriter
statement: Compute the minimum time to type the word on a circular alphabet dial, including one press per character.

title: Minimum Time to Type Word Using Special Typewriter
statement: Compute the minimum time to type the word on a circular alphabet dial, including one press per character.
code: class Solution { public int minTimeToType(String word){int pos=0,ans=0;for(char c:word.toCharArray()){int next=c-'a',d=Math.abs(next-pos);ans+=Math.min(d,26-d)+1;pos=next;}return ans;} }

title: Find Greatest Common Divisor of Array
statement: Return the greatest common divisor of the smallest and largest array values.

title: Find Greatest Common Divisor of Array
statement: Return the greatest common divisor of the smallest and largest array values.
code: class Solution { public int findGCD(int[] nums){int a=nums[0],b=nums[0];for(int x:nums){a=Math.min(a,x);b=Math.max(b,x);}while(b!=0){int t=a%b;a=b;b=t;}return a;} }

title: Final Value of Variable After Performing Operations
statement: Return the final value starting from zero after applying each operation.
code:
class Solution:
 def finalValueAfterOperations(self,operations):return sum(1 if '+' in x else -1 for x in operations)

title: Final Value of Variable After Performing Operations
statement: Return the final value starting from zero after applying each operation.
code: class Solution { public int finalValueAfterOperations(String[] operations){int ans=0;for(String s:operations)ans+=s.charAt(1)=='+'?1:-1;return ans;} }

title: Convert 1D Array Into 2D Array
statement: Reshape original into an m by n matrix, or return an empty array if sizes do not match.

title: Convert 1D Array Into 2D Array
statement: Reshape original into an m by n matrix, or return an empty array if sizes do not match.
code: class Solution { public int[][] construct2DArray(int[] original,int m,int n){if((long)m*n!=original.length)return new int[0][0];int[][]out=new int[m][n];for(int i=0;i<original.length;i++)out[i/n][i%n]=original[i];return out;} }

title: Two Out of Three
statement: Return distinct values that occur in at least two of the three arrays.
approach_name: Keep values present in at least two arrays
code:
import java.util.*;
class Solution { public List<Integer> twoOutOfThree(int[] nums1,int[] nums2,int[] nums3){Set<Integer>a=new HashSet<>(),b=new HashSet<>(),c=new HashSet<>();for(int x:nums1)a.add(x);for(int x:nums2)b.add(x);for(int x:nums3)c.add(x);Set<Integer>out=new TreeSet<>();for(int x:a)if(b.contains(x)||c.contains(x))out.add(x);for(int x:b)if(c.contains(x))out.add(x);return new ArrayList<>(out);} }

title: Minimum Number of Moves to Seat Everyone
statement: Return the total absolute movement needed to assign each student to a seat.
code:
class Solution:
 def minMovesToSeat(self,seats,students):return sum(abs(a-b) for a,b in zip(sorted(seats),sorted(students)))

title: Minimum Number of Moves to Seat Everyone
statement: Return the total absolute movement needed to assign each student to a seat.
code:
import java.util.*;
class Solution { public int minMovesToSeat(int[] seats,int[] students){Arrays.sort(seats);Arrays.sort(students);int ans=0;for(int i=0;i<seats.length;i++)ans+=Math.abs(seats[i]-students[i]);return ans;} }
